newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: SOCCER-DUTCH RECALL KLUIVERT FOR BELGIUM QUALIFIER.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-DUTCH RECALL KLUIVERT FOR BELGIUM QUALIFIER.

text.p: Ajax striker Patrick Kluivert was recalled on Monday to the Netherlands squad for Saturday's World Cup qualifier against Belgium in Brussels.

Kluivert last played for the Dutch during the European Championships in England in June. He has missed much of his club's poor start to the season through injury, but last week he grabbed the winner in Ajax's crucial 1-0 win over Grasshopper in Zurich to keep alive the Dutch champions' hopes of European Cup success.
Both the Dutch and the Belgians, fierce Low Countries rivals, have won their two opening games in Europe's group seven, with the Dutch thrashing Wales 7-1 in Eindhoven.
Belgium beat the Netherlands 1-0 the last time the two neighbours met, in the first round of the 1994 World Cup.
Goalkeepers - Edwin van der Sar (Ajax), Ed de Goey (Feyenoord);
Defence - Frank de Boer (Ajax), Jaap Stam, Stan Valckx, Arthur Numan (PSV Eindhoven), Ferdi Vierklau (Vitesse), Michael Reiziger (AC Milan);
Midfield - Ronald de Boer (Ajax), Wim Jonk (PSV), Giovanni van Bronckhorst (Feyenoord), Aron Winter (Inter Milan), Clarence Seedorf (Real Madrid);
Attack - Marc Overmars, Patrick Kluivert (Ajax), Pierre van Hooijdonk (Celtic), Dennis Bergkamp (Arsenal), Phillip Cocu (PSV).
